notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to untap Daring Thief.
An opponent must control a permanent that shares a type with the one you wish to exchange.
description:
Untap Daring Thief using any method. It triggers, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Demonic Pact.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.
